proposition.object:
## What are the current Kalshi odds?

Odds as of October 3, 2026 at 20:15 UTC. Each price is the middle of the bid and the ask, read as a probability; the market lists 17 outcomes and 102 thousand contracts traded in the last 24 hours.

- **Above 4.3650**: 88% (bid 86 cents, ask 89 cents; 18 thousand contracts in 24 hours)
- **Above 4.3750**: 6% (bid 4 cents, ask 7 cents; 16 thousand contracts in 24 hours)
- **Above 4.3700**: 28% (bid 28 cents, ask 29 cents; 15 thousand contracts in 24 hours)
- **Above 4.3800**: 3% (bid 1 cents, ask 4 cents; 12 thousand contracts in 24 hours)
- **Above 4.3850**: 1% (bid 0 cents, ask 1 cents; 12 thousand contracts in 24 hours)
- **Above 4.3600**: 98% (bid 97 cents, ask 98 cents; 6 thousand contracts in 24 hours)
- **Above 4.3900**: 1% (bid 0 cents, ask 1 cents; 4 thousand contracts in 24 hours)
- **Above 4.4200**: 1% (bid 0 cents, ask 1 cents; 4 thousand contracts in 24 hours)

Prices change with every trade; the [live Kalshi market](https://kalshi.com/markets/kxaaagasd/us-gas-price-up/kxaaagasd-26oct04) is the current figure.

## What is our view?

KXAAAGASD daily markets quoted at 97 to 98 cents about 8 hours before close settled YES 99.8% of the time in our sample (2,107 markets; 95% interval 99.5% to 99.9%). The above 4.3600 contract is quoted at 97 to 98 cents: a favorite that pays little when it wins.

## How does this market resolve?

> If average regular gas prices for United States are strictly greater than $4.3400 on Oct 4, 2026 according to AAA, then the market resolves to Yes.

Close: October 4, 2026 at 03:59 UTC. Expected settlement: October 4, 2026 at 14:00 UTC. Settlement source: [AAA](https://gasprices.aaa.com/). Full terms: [Kalshi contract terms](https://assets.kalshi.com/contract_terms/AAAGAS.pdf).

## What could move the odds?

- The release of the named data series (the settlement source), or a revision to it.
- For daily published series such as gas prices, the latest published value relative to the strike: these series move a fraction of a cent a day, so the odds only swing when the value sits near a strike.
- A rules clarification or settlement-source change published by Kalshi on the market page.
- Order-book depth: thin books move on small orders, so a large price move on little volume says little.

## How reliable are markets like this one?

Across 116 settled Economics markets in our sample (Kalshi, 2026-09-29 to 2026-10-03), the Kalshi mid-price about 24 hours before close had a Brier error of 0.1108; a coin-flip price scores 0.25 and lower is better. Contracts quoted at 5 cents or less settled YES 0% of the time (20 markets); contracts quoted at 95 cents or more settled YES 97% (31 markets). The sample covers a few weeks, so it is a guide to how markets like this have behaved, not a guarantee of how this one will settle.

## Frequently asked questions

### What are the odds on "US gas prices tomorrow"?

As of October 3, 2026 at 20:15 UTC, Kalshi implies Above 4.3700 at 28%, Above 4.3650 at 88%, and Above 4.3750 at 6%. These move with every trade; the live market is at https://kalshi.com/markets/kxaaagasd/us-gas-price-up/kxaaagasd-26oct04.

### What does a price on Kalshi mean as a probability?

A contract that pays $1 if the outcome happens and trades at 45 cents implies about a 45% chance, before fees and ignoring the small gap between the bid and the ask. We take the middle of the bid and the ask.

### When does this market close and settle?

It closes October 4, 2026 at 03:59 UTC and is expected to settle October 4, 2026 at 14:00 UTC, in about 8 hours from the time of writing.

### Where does the settlement data come from?

Kalshi names AAA (https://gasprices.aaa.com/) as the settlement source. The full contract terms are at https://assets.kalshi.com/contract_terms/AAAGAS.pdf.

### Can I bet on this on Kalshi?

Kalshi is a federally regulated exchange (a CFTC-designated contract market). Whether you can trade depends on your location and eligibility under Kalshi's terms. The market is at https://kalshi.com/markets/kxaaagasd/us-gas-price-up/kxaaagasd-26oct04.

### Is this financial advice?

No. This wire reports a market's odds and its publisher's analysis from public information. Prediction-market contracts can lose their entire price.
